notes.title: Updated patches, bugs, and interface instructions on September 7, 2023
notes.content:
At the request of the player, the update status is as follows:
1、Tavern Recruitment: Expand the recruitment of heroes within the tavern to level 5, where players can randomly recruit higher level heroes.
2、Monster Plot Fighting: Shortened the overly complicated monster plot fighting and made corresponding adjustments.
3、Modified the situation of jumping out of the game directly after a battle failure.
4、There have been some adjustments made to the hero's combat skills.Fix the chances of dizziness, burning, and poisoning.
5、Add a pop-up prompt on the big map to prevent players from repeatedly entering completed scenes without knowing.
6、Modify the time and frequency of the hero's self talk dialogue jumping out.
7、Added the ending plot of the game.
8、Changed the font size of the combat interface button to make it easier to click.
9、Revised the English layout and enlarged some unclear fonts.
10、Modified the bug that is not displayed on the treasure chest weapon blueprint.

notes.title: Introduction to 8 Occupations in "Dawn Destiny's Child"
notes.content:
paladin
The front row meat shield with auxiliary gain can protect the rear row output heroes. His exclusive weapon increases health and defense the highest, especially in the later stage when combined with advanced weapons and treasures, coupled with his exclusive buff skills, it will become a super tank.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Two-handed swordsmanship
Hit 100%，100% attack，Hit one or two
Skill 2:Leadership banner
All increase accuracy
Skill 3:Horn of array
Increase overall defense
Skill 4:Charge horn
Increased critical strike rate overall
Skill 5:Guardian sword
Taunt all members of the enemy,after success,they will only attack themselves for 2 rounds,and increase their defense by 50% for 2 rounds.

warrior
warrior who have both offensive and defensive abilities can defend and attack. Generally speaking, it is better to match them in the front row. Although the defense of warrior is not comparable to that of paladins, and they do not have the various types of gains and bonuses of paladins, warriors can designate protection for heroes with weak defense. Among all the exclusive weapons of heroes, only the warrior's exclusive weapon has a "block bonus". If equipped with advanced weapons and treasures in the later stage, the warrior's defense ability may not be inferior to that of the paladin.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Shield strike
60% attack, 90% hit,causing the opponent to stun for 2 round and attack position 1,2
Skill 2:Thump
100% attack,attack position 1,2 ，hit 85%.
Skill 3:Violent
Increases critical strike chance by30% for 2 rounds.
Skill 4:Block
Increases your block rate by 50% for 2 rounds.
Skill 5:Guard
Increases defense by 30% for 2 rounds,and designates to protect a teammate.


hunter
Hunter is the most stable rear output, with a dual attribute bonus of high accuracy and high attack. She can group attack, her hunting dogs can cause bleeding damage to enemies, and the barking of the hunting dogs can relieve the hero's dizziness state.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Sundering Arrow
100% attack, 100% hit,50% armor break,30% damage to markers,attack position 3, 4.
Skill 2:Arrow rain
60% attack,attack all positions,hit 75%.
Skill 3:Hound biting
50% attack,3 additional bleeds,100% hit.
Skill 4:Dog bark
Relieve vertigo ，monomer
Skill 5:Whistling arrow
10% attack,Mark the target for 2 rounds，90% hit.

thieves
thieves is a high attack, high agility, high dodge, and high critical strike profession. With excellent attributes, he is the hero with the least health and defense among all heroes. Therefore, please protect his fragile nature and place him in the back row.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Assassination
100% attack, 100% hit,attack damage increased by 100% in stealth state,attack position 3, 4
Skill 2:Separate
70% attack, hit 100%,cause blood to target for 2 turns,attack position 1, 2.
Skill 3:Stealth
You are not attacked for 2 rounds,and increase the critical strike rate by 30%,Once you attack the target,the stealth status ends.
Skill 4:Theft
Has a chance to steal treasure, money, weapons,memory fragments, etc.from the target.
Skill 5:Flying knife
70% attack,100% damage to marked targets,attack position 3, 4

goddess
goddess has strong healing abilities and enhancement attributes, as well as the ability to dispel negative attributes, making her an indispensable member of the team.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Holy water treatment
Monomer therapy
Skill 2:Holy Radiance
Whole treatment
Skill 3:Blessing
Add 10% accuracy for 2 rounds to a teammate and 10% dodge for 2 rounds.
Skill 4:Chanting
Relieve dizziness and bleeding
Skill 5:Holy Light strike
40% damage, 100% hit,stun the opponent for 2 rounds.

witch
The witch's dark magic has a sustained strike and benefit reduction effect on enemies, and when attacking some BOSS, it often has unexpected effects.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Curse of Weakness
10% attack, hit 100%, reduce target's 20% attack and 20%defense for 2 rounds,and mark target 2 rounds at the same time.
Skill 2:Poison mist
10% attack, group attack,attack position 1,2,3,4 ,causing the opponent to poison 3,rounds,hit 100%.
Skill 3:Therapeutic potion
Treat small amount of blood, cure bleeding and poisoning.
Skill 4:Demon flame
20% attack,burning effect for 2 rounds,100% hit.
Skill 5:Ice storm
30%攻击,causing the opponent to freeze for 3 rounds,90% hit,all attacks.


druid
Druids can transform into three forms: werewolf, cheetah, and giant bear to fight against enemies. These three different animal forms enhance their different combat attributes, making them a versatile hand with both front and rear rows.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Turn into a werewolf
Self attack and crit increase,defense and evasion decrease,and three transformations cannot overlap.
Skill 2:Transformed into a bear
Self defense and physique increase,attack and agility decrease,the three transformations cannot overlap.
Skill 3:Turned leopard
Increased agility and evasion,reduced physique and crit,the three transformations cannot overlap.
Skill 4:Kill
100% attack, 100% hit,attack 1 and 2 positions,if it is a transfiguration state,increase accuracy by 30%.
Skill 5:Restore
Restore adult

mage
The magic damage of a mage is the highest among all heroes in terms of attack. If equipped with advanced exclusive weapons, he will have a very terrifying rear output, and as a powerful rear output, his defense is also weak.
Exclusive Skills:
Skill 1:Lightning Strike
100% hit，100% attack
Skill 2:Chain lightning
60% attack，all attacks，80% hit
Skill 3:Tornado
50% attack，dizzy the opponent 2 rounds,90% hit
Skill 4:Staff of the Holy Spirit
Restore a small amount of life
Skill 5:Chanting
Increase your own 3-round attack

notes.title: On the Types of Weapon Forging
notes.content:
There are a total of 115 weapons in the game "Dawn Destiny's Child", of which 107 weapons can be manufactured through drawings and minerals. Some advanced weapons can also be synthesized using two low-level weapons, which require either Shining Fragment or Glory Fragment.
The drawings, minerals, and fragments used to make weapons can be obtained through: 1. roadside items. 2. Monster drop. 3. Obtained through story content. 4. Make corresponding choices when talking to NPC.
Please note that there is a probability of failure when making advanced weapons. If you fail, you may lose all the materials you used to manufacture weapons.
If you want to improve the success rate of weapon production, you need corresponding fragments.

notes.title: Dawn Destiny's Child was officially released on August 8, 2023
notes.content:
The complete version of 'Dawn Destiny's Child' has been officially launched and is currently on sale and promotion. We hope to receive the love and support of players.
The game "Dawn Destiny's Child", which has been developed by two people for over four years, has been officially released. This game is a turn based battle and multi ending storyline game. The main feature is an immersive storyline experience, with a total of 11 endings, each with a completely different storyline, which depends on the player's different choices in interacting with NPCs in the game. The plot timeline spans different eras, and we have attempted to create a grand and vast background world, but due to limited personnel and limited energy, there are currently only 11 plot lines. I hope you enjoy it.
If possible, we hope to continue developing the next chapter.
As this is the first time we have released the game on Steam, we hope to receive more feedback and suggestions from everyone. We will always follow the forum. Of course, you can also send messages to our email.
Our email address: alanruochu_3846@foxmail.com
Sincere thanks!
ZHAO BIN
